_note: Adding a language: append an entry here, add slugs/<code>.json mapping every English article slug to the local one, then run langlinks.py. It rewrites the alternates block and the switcher on EVERY page in EVERY language, so languages already shipped pick up the new one without being hand-edited. Order here is the order they appear in the switcher and in the <head>.
_note_home: A top path is what a visitor sees. The homepages are folders: "" is https://amazebase.pro/ (its canonical), "es/" is /es/ -- each served from index.html by the Caddyfile's try_files; langlinks.file_of() maps a path to its file.
